allocation.name: Equities
allocation.meaning: Shares and the equity portions of investment funds.

allocation.name: Private equity
allocation.meaning: Investments in companies outside public stock markets, including fund allocations.

allocation.name: Bonds
allocation.meaning: Debt securities and the bond portions of funds.

allocation.name: Liquidity
allocation.meaning: Net cash balances with accrued interest included; positive and negative currency accounts are netted.

allocation.name: Hedge funds
allocation.meaning: Funds classified by the bank as hedge funds.

allocation.name: Real estate participations
allocation.meaning: Property-related investments and portions of funds.

allocation.name: Others
allocation.meaning: Remaining amounts in the bank allocation.

allocation.name: Short-term investments
allocation.meaning: The bank net allocation to short-term investments, including fund components.

allocation.name: Derivatives
allocation.meaning: Net marked values attributed to derivatives, not contract notional amounts.

allocation.name: Credit / borrowing
allocation.meaning: Fixed advances owed to the bank, including accrued debit interest; negative cash accounts are classified separately under Liquidity.
